matches.rationale: The single finding discusses an MSE vs. L2-norm loss function discrepancy in Eq. (5), which is unrelated to the masking/recovery inconsistency regarding POI and road network modalities described in GT1.
The finding does not address SC-MoE gating formulation, noisy top-K gating details, or expert blending; it is about a different equation (temporal loss) entirely, so it does not detect GT2.
